layout.hierarchy: The oversized bold red 'Recall' title dominates the top. Next in weight are the large black definition lines in the gray banner and the red 'Meaning' heading. The red-outlined Recall fraction box is the visual anchor of the left column, with the smaller blue Precision box secondary. On the right, the two blue-framed confusion matrices and the large red-framed tree panel form a dense, saturated column of red/green/blue graphics that competes strongly with the left text. Color coding (red = positive/true-positive emphasis, green = negative/true-negative, blue = predicted/precision) is the main organizing device.

recreation_brief:
1. Set the canvas to a 900x480 px (approx 1.875:1) white slide; draw a thin red (#FF0000) rectangle outline from about (55,38) to (845,460), and a solid black rectangle from (35,460) to (835,480) along the bottom edge.
2. Add the title 'Recall' in bold dark-red (#C00000) sans-serif, approx 44-48 pt, centered at about x=390, y=72 (top-center of the left column).
3. Add a gray (#D9D9D9) rectangle from (67,98) to (615,155). Inside, place two centered bold black lines: 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' (approx 18 pt) at y~115 and 'Total objects that should be retrieved (Actually Positive)' (approx 18 pt) at y~143; draw a red 2-3 px horizontal line from (75,123) to (605,123) between them.
4. Add a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) rectangle from (67,177) to (578,228). Put 'Meaning' in bold red (#C00000), approx 26 pt, at the top-left of the box; below it the bold black line 'Does the classifier miss any of Positive Objects ?' (approx 18 pt) with 'miss' in red underlined and 'Positive' in blue (#0070C0) underlined.
5. Add a red-outlined rounded rectangle from (67,235) to (298,283) with white fill. Inside, place bold black 'Recall =' at the left, then a fraction: 'TP' above a black horizontal bar and 'TP + FN' below it, right-aligned to the bar.
6. Add a light-blue (#EAF3FA) rectangle with a thin blue border from (315,258) to (495,298); put 'Precision= 18/(18+12)' in black (approx 14 pt) on the first line and '=60%' in blue (#0070C0) bold on the second line.
7. Add two callout notes with pointer tails: a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) note at (108,305)-(200,335) with a tail pointing up-right toward the 'TP' numerator, text 'Positive' / 'Classified as +ve'; a peach (#FCE4D6) note at (210,305)-(300,335) with a tail pointing up toward 'FN', text 'Positive' / 'Classified as -ve'. Both in small bold black.
8. Draw a green (#00B050) horizontal curly brace (opening upward) from x=100 to x=315 at y~348, and place the red italic caption 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset' centered beneath it at y~366.
9. Add a light-blue (#EAF3FA) rectangle with a medium-blue (#4472C4) border from (72,410) to (467,452); inside, two lines of blue (#0070C0) italic text: 'If you said: I picked ALL Positive objects,' and 'can I trust you ?   At what % ?'.
10. Build the top-right symbolic confusion matrix: blue (#0000FF) rectangle border from (630,45) to (815,145); red bold 'Predicted as' centered at the top; red vertical 'Actual' at the left; a 2x2 table with red grid lines, column headers 'P' and 'N' on top and row headers 'P' and 'N' on the left; fill the TP cell (row P/col P) and TN cell (row N/col N) with light green (#92D050), leave FN and FP white; label cells 'TP', 'FN', 'FP', 'TN' in black.
11. Add a pale-yellow (#FFFF99) circle of about 26 px diameter centered near (822,63), overlapping the top-right corner of that panel, with black '10' inside.
12. Build the numeric confusion matrix below it: blue rectangle border from (630,148) to (815,250); red bold 'Predicted as' at top; vertical red 'Actual' at left; red 2x2 grid with 'P'/'N' column and row headers. Put '18' in a dark-blue (#1F3864) circle with white text in the row P/col P cell, '12' in an orange (#F4B183) circle with black text in row P/col N, plain black '10' in row N/col P, and '60' in a green (#00B050) circle with white text in row N/col N. Add a small white mouse-pointer arrow overlapping the lower-right of the '60' cell.
13. Build the tree panel: red (#FF0000) rectangle border from (502,255) to (825,445). Place red bold 'Positive' at (590,268) and green bold 'Negative' at (760,268). Insert the two gray line-art fish images beneath these headings (left fish approx 80x35 px at (550,285); right fish approx 80x35 px at (690,285)).
14. Add filled circles (approx 30 px diameter) with white bold numbers: red (#C00000) '30' at (580,350), green (#00B050) '70' at (750,350), red '18' at (540,405), green '12' at (620,405), green '60' at (710,405), red '10' at (790,405).
15. Draw blue (#0000FF) straight arrows with arrowheads from the '30' circle down-left to '18' and down-right to '12', and from the '70' circle down-left to '60' and down-right to '10'.
16. Add small bold labels beneath the leaf circles: 'TP' in red under 18, 'FN' in red under 12, 'TN' in green under 60, 'FP' in red under 10.
